title: Expose the authenticated independent uploader

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Python tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m pytest tests/test_foundation.py tests/unit

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-001 RED: before production behavior changes, add and run the isolated same-origin photographer journey; retain the claim-scoped failure showing that login, target selection and independent valid/invalid/undecodable/mixed-EXIF outcome reporting are absent.

FT-001-AC-001 GREEN: the claim-equivalent journey must record each file's HTTP/UI outcome, selected spa_id/visit_date, persisted authoritative date, EXIF warning behavior, decisive comparison and screenshot/response/database artifact without one file changing another.

FT-001-AC-004 RED: in disposable state, the pre-implementation auth/role/CSRF/rate/topology/redaction probe must fail the accepted boundary claims rather than using an artificial syntax or setup failure; retain all independently harm-driving failed assertions.

FT-001-AC-004 GREEN: fresh probes must record unauthenticated 401, wrong-role and CSRF 403, successful below-limit requests, configured above-limit 429, HTTPS-only host publication, private PostgreSQL/MinIO/internal ports, and absence of passwords/session/CSRF tokens, headers, hashes, object keys and storage credentials from URLs/logs, with pass/fail comparisons and artifacts.

Staff lifecycle evidence records Argon2id-only password persistence, CLI provision/reset/deactivate, absolute expiry, logout, session revocation after reset/deactivation, cookie attributes and safe repeated deactivation using isolated test credentials.

The T3 probe records its unique Compose project, disposable volumes/test credentials, explicit limit values, task-owned MinIO prefix, safe rerun and cleanup; it never touches operator/default state or expands permissions.

Independent /verify evidence supplies fresh functional proof for every harm-driving claim and VERDICT: PASS; per-task /red-verify supplies SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass and the explicit owner records HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done before closure.
purpose: Expose the complete FT-001 photographer outcome through a minimal same-origin staff session and a secure, rate-limited one-file HTTPS upload UI/API that delegates all admission behavior to inventory.
success_outcome: An active photographer can log in, select one configured СПА and authoritative visit_date, submit multiple ready-JPEG candidates as independent requests, and see truthful accepted/rejected/duplicate results while wrong/expired/revoked roles, CSRF failures and excess rates are rejected and internal stores, ports and secrets remain private.
anti_goals: Do not duplicate Photo admission, serving-target or pending-state business logic in FastAPI/UI/platform-auth/composition code; use TASK-003's inventory boundary.
Do not add OAuth, MFA, self-registration, browser password recovery, multi-role policy machinery, distributed rate limiting or a custom HTTP error framework.
Do not add Batch/manifest/confirmation, external ingest, RAW, resumable upload, direct/presigned MinIO access or a second upload API.
Do not implement FT-002 processing/searchability or FT-012 Photo inventory management.

forbidden_scope: Direct HTTP/UI/platform-auth writes to Photo, Spa, processing or MinIO repositories
FT-002 processing/searchable behavior and FT-012 inventory operations
Production deployment/certificates, public service/store ports, real operator credentials or operator/default persistent data
OAuth/MFA/self-registration/recovery, distributed limiter/cache, custom error registry or additional ingest channels
stop_conditions: Execution requires changing the canonical endpoint, response, staff role, session/CSRF, rate-limit, authoritative-date or standard failure contract.
Business orchestration cannot remain under inventory or would need direct cross-slice writes or placement in a handler, generic utility or composition root.
A public PostgreSQL/MinIO/internal port, browser-visible object key/credential or plaintext/digest secret in URL/logs becomes necessary.
Any harm-driving RED/GREEN or security verification cannot run in already authorized isolated disposable state with safe rerun and owned cleanup.

constraints: Primary business owner remains inventory at src/face_moment/inventory/; platform/auth authenticates, the inventory application boundary authorizes and admits, and FastAPI/UI only adapt transport.
Implement the exact same-origin routes, fields, response shapes and standard status mappings from the Photo Admission API without a parallel API or shared error framework.

Use Argon2id, opaque high-entropy hashed sessions, one configured positive absolute TTL, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite session cookie, matching CSRF cookie/header and owner-backed provision/reset/deactivate commands.
Use deployment-configured positive username/IP login and principal/session/IP upload limits with deterministic test values; the one-backend pilot adds no distributed store or waiter queue.
Keep PostgreSQL, MinIO and internal application ports private behind the existing HTTPS edge; never expose object keys or credentials to the browser.
Exact owner-local module/template/static filenames and dependency package versions remain implementation discretion where they preserve the canonical API, data and security contracts.
invariants: Only an active photographer principal may enter Photo admission; missing/invalid/expired/revoked authentication returns 401 and wrong role or CSRF returns 403.
Every selected file is one independent request and visible row; there is no Batch, manifest, confirmation or cross-file commit/result dependency.
The submitted visit_date stays authoritative; mixed EXIF may warn but cannot rewrite, regroup or reject that scope solely for mismatch.
Configured excess upload rate returns standard HTTP 429 without weakening authentication, CSRF or private-service topology.
Passwords, plaintext/digest session and CSRF tokens, auth headers, object keys and storage credentials never enter URLs or application logs.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-001: isolated same-origin journey covers active login, target/date selection and independent valid, invalid, undecodable, mixed-EXIF and duplicate file results with persisted authoritative-date comparison.
FT-001-AC-004: fresh isolated probes cover 401, role/CSRF 403, below-limit success, above-limit 429, HTTPS-only publication, private internal services and secret/object-key redaction.
REQ-SEC-001: record configured rate conditions, cookie/CSRF attributes, observed statuses, effective Compose topology, redacted logs and explicit pass/fail comparison artifacts.
REQ-ARCH-001: boundary evidence locates orchestration in inventory and proves transport/platform-auth/composition code performs no foreign business writes.
